query: New international software M&A advisors and serial software buyers for independent technical due diligence partnerships; six verified official sites; do not treat prospect interest as verified.

records.name: Spector M&A
records.relevance: Nordic boutique serving software and agentic AI founders and PE; offers financial transaction diligence but technology DD is a potential complementary service. Outreach angle: independent technical diligence module alongside SaaS financial diligence.

sources.note: Official site: partners, 450+ claimed technology transactions, financial DD and contact information.
PE transaction diligence offering; technology diligence partnership is an unverified hypothesis.

records.name: Capital Row
records.relevance: Vertical software M&A advisory with pre-market financial reviews and buyer acquisition criteria. Angle: pair financial pre-market assessment with technical architecture, API and security readiness.

sources.note: Official website: vertical software M&A and buy-side sourcing.
Official website publicly lists team@thecapitalrow.com and pre-market assessment.

records.name: Software Capital Advisors
records.relevance: Software-only sell-side investment bank; prepares founder-owned companies for buyer diligence. Angle: fixed-scope pre-exit technical risk review and evidence-based remediation list.

sources.note: Official site: software-only sell-side M&A and pre-market preparation.
Official contact page publicly lists email.

records.name: VVV Equity Partners
records.relevance: Permanent-capital acquirer of vertical systems-of-record; acquired TurboPT in May 2026 and AutoRaptor in December 2024. Angle: repeatable technical diligence for EHR and automotive CRM acquisitions, focusing on data migrations and integration risks.

sources.note: Official portfolio page: May 2026 TurboPT acquisition, prior AutoRaptor acquisition and public email.

records.name: Verticor
records.relevance: Independent sponsor targeting mission-critical vertical software with $2m-$30m annual revenue. Angle: independent technical second opinion on AI transformation feasibility, software debt and security during investment diligence.

sources.note: Official site: Anthony Odie Founder & Partner, public email, investment criteria and strategic M&A.

records.name: Apex Point Equity
records.relevance: Micro-PE asset purchaser of founder-led B2B SaaS with $500k+ ARR. Angle: cost-controlled technical red-flag assessment before asset purchase, with security, dependencies, IP ownership and handover checks.

sources.note: Official site: investment thesis, Eric Spielman and Alen Durbuzovic, public email.
